newsitem.title: CHINA: Blue Ribbon China Group to open new brewery.
newsitem.headline: Blue Ribbon China Group to open new brewery.

text.p: A Hong Kong company has signed an agreement with a Chinese firm and a brewery in southwestern China to produce Pabst Blue Ribbon Beer, officials said on Friday.

Hong Kong Weixun Investment Co Ltd, Blue Ribbon China Group Co Ltd and Emei Brewery in Leshan, Sichuan province, signed a 60 million yuan ($7.2 million) deal to set up the Sichuan Blue Ribbon Beer Co Ltd, an official with Blue Ribbon China said.
Blue Ribbon China had a 51 percent stake in the new venture, while the brewery held 29 percent and Hong Kong Weixun the remaining 20 percent, the official said by telephone.

The project, Blue Ribbon China's third in China, would rennovate facilities at the Emei Brewery, which in March 1997, would begin producing 43,000 tonnes of the popular U.S. brand a year, she said. Annual ouput was expected to reach 100,000 tonnes within a few years, she said.
Blue Ribbon China, in which the U.S. firm Pabst Blue Ribbon has no stake, has two other breweries in southern Guangdong.

Blue Ribbon China has been trying to combat rampant smuggling and bootlegging of the U.S. brand. Official reports have said 3.5 billion yuan of Blue Ribbon was smuggled into China between 1990 and last year, mainly through Hong Kong.
